I will retain the existing figure size, title, x-axis label, stacked histogram style, borders, and tick rotation. source = '''import seaborn as sns import matplotlib.pyplot as plt import pandas as pd import numpy as np df = pd.read_csv('table.csv') bounds = df['FundingPerMonthMillions'].str.split('-', expand=True).astype(float) df['FundingMidpoint'] = bounds.mean(axis=1) bin_edges = np.sort(np.unique(bounds.to_numpy())) regions = ['Metro North', 'Metro South', 'Suburban East', 'Rural West', 'Metro Central', 'Suburban North', 'Rural North'] plt.figure(figsize=(12, 7)) sns.set_style("whitegrid") sns.set_palette("husl", 7) histplot = sns.histplot( data=df, x='FundingMidpoint', weights='NumberOfProjects', hue='Region', hue_order=regions, palette=dict(zip(regions, sns.color_palette("husl", 7))), bins=bin_edges, multiple='stack', edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5 ) histplot.set_title('Distribution of Monthly Funding Across Regions', fontsize=16, pad=20) histplot.set_xlabel('Monthly Funding (Millions USD)', fontsize=12) histplot.set_ylabel('Number of Projects', fontsize=12) histplot.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45) plt.tight_layout() plt.savefig('output.png') ''' Path("chart.py").write_text(source) plt.close("all") exec(compile(source, "chart.py", "exec")) ax = plt.gca() print("Title:", ax.get_title()) print("Labels:", ax.get_xlabel(), "/", ax.get_ylabel()) print("Legend:", [t.get_text() for t in ax.get_legend().get_texts()]) print("Y limits:", ax.get_ylim()) expected = df.groupby('FundingPerMonthMillions', sort=False)['NumberOfProjects'].sum().to_numpy() actual = np.array([sum(p.get_height() for p in ax.patches if abs(p.get_x()-x)<1e-8) for x in bin_edges[:-1]]) print("Expected bin counts:", expected) print("Plotted bin counts:", actual) assert np.array_equal(expected, actual) continue
